title: Access and Analyze Global GreenSpace Spatial Data
text: greenSD provides tools access analyze multi-band greenspace seasonality data cubes (available 1,028 major global cities) global land cover/NDVI data ESA WorldCover 10m Dataset. Users can download data using bounding boxes, city names, coordinates, extract values specific points, filter year seasonal time window. Moreover, package. package also supports calculating human exposure greenspace using population-weighted greenspace exposure model based Global Human Settlement Layer (GHSL) population data computing set greenspace morphology metrics patch landscape levels.

title: Access and Analyze Global GreenSpace Spatial Data
text: 🌍 Access global greenspace datasets bounding box, city name, geographic coordinates - Seasonal greenspace data cubes 1028 major global cities - 10m NDVI composite data ESA WorldCover 🛰️ Remote sensing–based greenspace extraction - Automatically download process high-resolution images WorldImagery Sentinel-2 cloudless tiles (EOX) - Extract greenery map tiles - Retrieve Sentinel-2 L2A imagery compute NDVI extract raw bands 🧠 Multi-source land cover classification - Combine semantic segmentation remote sensing tiles land cover classification 🧮 Greenspace metrics calculation - Estimate population-weighted greenspace fraction (PWGF) - Calculate population-weighted greenspace exposure (PWGE) - Calculate morphological greenscape metrics (e.g., area, perimeter, shape, core area, contiguity) 📊 Visualization - Export multi-layer data animated GIFs

title: exposure — compute_exposure
text: r SpatRaster single/multiple greenspace layer(s), either fractional binary (non-green = 0 green = 1), typically output get_gsdc(), get_esa_wc(), get_tile_green(). res numeric vector length 2. actual spatial resolution (meters). Default c(10, 10). pop_year numeric. Year GHSL dataset use. Must one : 2015, 2020, 2025, 2030. Default 2020. radius numeric. Buffer radius (meters) used local averaging. Default 500. grid_size numeric. Optional. provided, output aggregated grid cells size (meters) returned sf object. height logical. Whether compute greenspace volume population-weighted greenspace fraction human exposure greenspace using Meta's global canopy height map (Tolan et al., 2024). (default FALSE) pop_out logical. Whether return population layer. quiet logical. Whether show progress bars process.

title: exposure — compute_exposure
text: SpatRaster sf. SpatRaster (grid_size NULL) layers pwgf_*, sf object columns pwge_* representing population-weighted greenspace exposure values aggregated grid polygon.

title: exposure — compute_exposure
text: function implements population-weighted greenspace exposure (PWGE) model: Start population raster. pixel \( \) population value \( P_i \). Create circular buffer radius \( d \) around pixel center. buffer, calculate greenspace fraction: $$G_i^d = \frac{\text{Area greenspace within buffer}}{\text{Total buffer area}}$$ Repeat \( = 1, 2, ..., N \) grid cells. Compute overall exposure: $$GE^d = \frac{\sum_i P_i \cdot G_i^d}{\sum_i P_i}$$

"landcover" "ndvi" retrieve ESA WorldCover data (years 2020–2021). "lulc" retrieves Sentinel-2 10m LULC Time Series (years 2017–2024). year numeric. year interest.
